quest.title: Fine Wine From Yesterday
quest.description: "Just now, I saw Master Diluc enter the tavern in a rush." "Oh? Is Master Diluc going to mix drinks personally today? Can't miss out on this one... Come on, help me up."

talks.objective: Talk to Luka and enter the tavern

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, it's Master Diluc! What brings you here? Do you have nothing to do today?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Heh, me? "Nothing to do"? Don't count on it. I heard you two were working as bartenders, so I thought I'd drop by to see how you're coming along.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, you really do catch wind of things quickly!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: #So, tell me, {NICKNAME}. How do you like being a bartender?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually, we just started...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, it's still a little too early to tell. We haven't been at it for very long.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Just tell me your initial feelings.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Excited? Confused? Anything. How does it feel to be a bartender?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, didn't you want to ask Paimon, too?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's initial feeling is... drinks taste good!

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Now, could you make me a Gray Valley Sunset, then? I'll leave the size up to you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure, I'll get that started for you.

talks.objective: Head to the counter and get ready to open for business

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Mmm. Not bad, not bad at all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's all about the ingredients! If the fruit are fresh and juicy, then the drink will naturally be sweet and tasty without adding anything extra.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Sounds like I should thank the soil of Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: It just so happens that Gray Valley Sunset is the first drink I ever mixed.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I was still quite young. My father laid out several ingredients and told me to experiment with them.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: No requirements and no instruction. In hindsight, he probably just wanted to test my creativity.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: In the end, I just made a glass of fruit punch, much like this one.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? But why fruit punch?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: My father was equally surprised. I didn't really put much thought into it, I just figured that it would taste sweet.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Looking back on it, I was so young and naive.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I wouldn't be so sure.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Oh?

choices.text: I'm sure your father thought it was a good drink.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: I've never thought about it, I suppose... My father didn't say a word at the time.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: By the way, there's something I'd like to give you.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: But, I suppose it's better to wait until you have more experience with your bartender job. I have no doubt that you'll do very well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And Paimon will... uh, be rooting for you! Hehe.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Very well. Then, I look forward to seeing your good work. See you around.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come back soon when you have a minute!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, this doesn't look like the drink they ordered. Just give this one to Paimon and try making another.
